name: com.moatpost/the-moat
title: THE MOAT — Global Business Intelligence
description: Editor-selected, source-first global business news for AI agents, each story credited and linked.

tools.name: daily_brief
tools.description: THE MOAT's front page for global business: the stories its editors selected for an edition, in page order, each with author, publication, language, country, a direct link to the original reporting and why THE MOAT selected it. Use it for "what matters in global business today" or for a given day. Returns references and links, never article text.

date.description: Brussels date of the edition (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit for the current edition.

language.description: Language of THE MOAT's own text in the response. V1: English. Sources keep their original language.

include_related.description: Also return other publications' versions and follow-up developments of each story.

tools.name: topic_brief
tools.description: Editor-selected coverage of a topic, company, industry, country or theme from THE MOAT's recent front pages (default: the last 7 days; at most 31). Only stories THE MOAT selected, never a web search. Each story comes with credits, language, country, direct links and why THE MOAT selected it.

query.description: A topic, company, industry, country or theme in a few words, e.g. "European energy", "semiconductor supply chains", "Nvidia", "competition policy", "shipping".

from.description: First Brussels date to include (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: 6 days before "to".

to.description: Last Brussels date to include (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today.

tools.name: compare_coverage
tools.description: How credible outlets in different languages and countries covered an issue, among the stories THE MOAT selected (last 14 days). Groups the coverage by the source's language and country so an agent can show the perspectives side by side. Titles stay in their original language: THE MOAT never translates or summarises the reporting.

query.description: A topic, company, industry, country or theme in a few words, e.g. "European energy", "semiconductor supply chains", "Nvidia", "competition policy", "shipping".

languages.description: Only sources in these languages (ISO 639-1, e.g. ["en","fr","de"]). Omit for all.

countries.description: Only publications from these markets (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, plus "EU" and "INT"). Omit for all.

limit.description: How many pieces of coverage in all (1–30).

tools.name: story_sources
tools.description: The source trail for one story THE MOAT selected: who reported it first, the version THE MOAT leads with, other publications' versions, follow-up developments and primary material (official releases, filings) where THE MOAT has them. Pass a story_id from daily_brief or topic_brief, or a query (searches the last 14 days).

story_id.description: A story or item id, e.g. "moat:story:271".

query.description: Words identifying the story, if no story_id is given.

include_related.description: Include other versions and follow-up developments.

include_primary_sources.description: Include primary material (official releases, filings) linked to the story.
